about_the_game:
Stack fast. Crash harder. Get certified.
Forklift Certified: Stacked & Loaded is a chaotic 4-player couch co-op party game where you and your crew take on the ultimate warehouse challenge. Load crates, dodge disasters, and try not to trip over the inventory—or each other.

Work together (or not) through stacks of levels escalating in logistical madness, from calm tutorial bays to frantic arenas full of crates, conveyor belts, and unpredictable warehouse hazards. Whether you're in the same room or using Steam Remote Play Together, teamwork is optional—fun is guaranteed.

🔑 Key Features

  • 4-Player Couch Co-op: Play locally or via Steam Remote Play Together.

  • Crate-Loads of Levels: From smooth operations to total catastrophe.

  • Certified Chaos: Drift, crash, launch, and occasionally deliver crates.

  • Unlock Achievements: Track your progress through the game and be rewarded.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 7th-gen intel or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 970 or equivalent
  • Sound Card: AC97 or equivalent

short_description: Chaos meets co-op in this fast-paced forklift frenzy! Team up with up to 4 players to stack, crash, and (barely) survive the warehouse floor. Master the forks, dodge disaster, and deliver perfection—kinda. You're not just licensed... you're Forklift Certified!
